module.purpose: Provides a memoized grouped row model builder for table state, recursively grouping rows by specified columns and aggregating values.
module.summary: This file implements the grouped row model used by the table core. It exports a higher-order function that returns a memoized function to compute a RowModel from the table's pre-grouped rows and grouping state. It recursively groups rows by existing column ids, builds hierarchical subRows, flattens leaf rows, and computes aggregated values via column aggregation functions. Rows are mutated to set depth, parentId, and grouping metadata. A helper reduces rows into a Map keyed by grouping value.
module.businessContext: Part of a data table UI library; responsible for grouping rows. If broken, tables won't display grouped/aggregated data.
